issues.problem: Story check: 《尚书·金縢》, Duke of Zhou offering himself in place of the ailing King Wu, 予仁若考，能多材多艺，能事鬼神. Details and source are correct.
ctx4 used the idiom as a bare exclamation after a full clause (赚来的，光明正大！), which reads awkwardly.
issues.action: rewrote as 来得光明正大 and adjusted the English

issues.problem: ctx4 (new waiter nearly spills soup carrying a tray) fits 手忙脚乱 from the same set just as well.
issues.action: rewrote so the clumsiness happens even when there are few customers, which rules out flustered rushing

issues.problem: ctx1 (Dad out from early till late, rarely eats with me) fits 起早贪黑 from the same set equally well.
issues.action: added a long commute as the reason, so the point is being away from home, not hard toil

issues.problem: ctx2 (studying for an exam all term) fits 废寝忘食 from the same set. Also, reg 'spoken' is too narrow: the idiom is common in written narrative.
issues.action: rewrote ctx2 as working two jobs to earn money; changed reg to neutral

issues.problem: ctx1 (累得气喘吁吁 after five floors) and ctx4 (halfway up a mountain, had to sit down and rest) also fit 筋疲力尽 from the same set.
issues.action: ctx1: 到了门口还在气喘吁吁 (still panting); ctx4: puffing after only a few flights of steps, so it means breathlessness, not exhaustion
